content: Aulataʼala Apili Manga Mia to Akarajaa Kema tee Parakakasina
KAWASANA OPU afirimani i Musa,
"Kamatea, Iaku padhamo kukemba Bezaleel bin Uri bin Hur, minaaka i lipu Yuda.
Padhamo kudhawua Rohina Aulataʼala, tee hikimati, kakidha, tee ilimuu;
incia amakidha akarajaa pegiu-giu modele minaaka i bulawa, pera tee tambaga;
incia amakidha abheloki bhatu tundu tee atalea. Incia uka amembali abheloki kau, tee apewau sagala giu karajaa mosagaanana.

Iaku uka padhamo kupili mia to apobhawa tee incia, siitumo Aholiab bin Ahisamakh minaaka i lipu Dan. Tee Iaku uka padhamo kudhawua hikimati i nuncana ngangarandana bhari-bharia mia ahalii. Manga incia tabeana apewaua bhari-bharia mopadhana iparintaakaku i ingkoo:
Kema Pokawaana tee Aulataʼala, Soronga Pojanjia tee katutubhina i bhawona, siitumo tampana to ahapusuaka dosa, tee sagala parakakasina kema sumai,
siitumo meja tee parakakasina, padamara minaaka i bulawa asilii tee sagala parakakasina, tampana tunuana dhupa,
tampana tunuana kurubani tee sagala parakakasina, palanggana kapebhahoka tee kalempesina,
pakea itanu, siitumo pakea momangkilo to Harun tee manga anana wakutuuna manga incia akarajaa tugasina amembali imamu,
mina idhupai, tee dhupa minaaka i manga rampa mawondu to tampa momangkilo. Manga incia tabeana akarajaaia apokana tee bhari-bharia iparintaakaku i ingkoo."
Kaudhania to Apekangkilo Eona Saputuu
KAWASANA OPU afirimani i Musa,

"Pogauakea i miana Israel, 'Ingkomiu tabeana uudhania eona Saputuu roonamo siitumo tanda kaudhania i tanga-tangaku tee siwulumiu mamudhaakana ingkomiu umataua Iakumo KAWASANA OPU mopekangkilona ingkomiu.

Rampaakanamo sumai, udhania eona Saputuu. Roonamo eona Saputuu satotuuna eo momangkilo to ingkomiu. Incema mopekarombua, dhaanamo atohukumu mate roonamo incemapo uka mokarajaana i eo incia sumai tabeana inyawana atopaila minaaka i tanga-tangana lipuna.
Dhaangia nama eo to takarajaa, maka i eo pitu eona satotuuna eo poniuntoa. Ande ukarajaa i eona Saputuu tee inda uraraeaakea, ingkomiu bheutohukumu mate.
Sababuna sumai miana Israel tabeana audhania eona Saputuu tee araraeaakea bhari-bharia siwuluna mboomo saangu pojanjia saʼumurua.

Eona Saputuu amembali tandana kaudhania i tanga-tangaku tee miana Israel to saʼumurua, roonamo KAWASANA OPU apadhaangia laiana tee alamu kangengena nama eo, tee i eo pitu eona Incia auntomo akarajaa to aponiunto."
Nabii Musa Atarima Rua Angu Katongkana Bhatu Hukumu
Sapadhana KAWASANA OPU afirimani i Musa i Gunu Sinai, Incia adhawuakea rua angu katongkana bhatu motoburiakana tee hukumuna KAWASANA OPU, siitumo katongkana bhatu iburina karona KAWASANA OPU.
